primitives.name: Orchestration Delegation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: --name: claude-delegate description: >Delegate a coding task to a separate Claude Code CLI process or another Claude session as an implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{O}^{\\text{orch}}_{\\text{claude}}': 'Orchestrator operator', '\\mathcal{O}^{\\text{impl}}_{\\text{claude}}': 'Implementer operator', '\\mathcal{O}^{\\text{land}}_{\\text{user}}': 'User land operator', '\\mathcal{O}^{\\text{review}}_{\\text{user}}': 'User review operator'}
primitives.assumptions: Task is bounded, agent has sufficient context, and environment supports shell and git.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \mathcal{O}^{\text{impl}}_{\text{claude}} \to \mathcal{O}^{\text{land}}_{\text{user}}$ fails due to sandbox or credential misalignment.

layer2.mapping: The kernel \mathcal{K}^{\text{delegate}} \cong \mathcal{O}^{\text{orch}} \times \mathcal{O}^{\text{impl}} \to \mathcal{O}^{\text{land}} \times \mathcal{O}^{\text{review}}$ mirrors the structure of a control loop with feedback.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of task completion and diff review accuracy.

primitives.name: Sandboxed Execution Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: Claude's shell sandbox requires macOS, Linux, or WSL2; native Windows launch is pending verification.
primitives.assumptions: Execution environment is isolated and constrained by shell sandbox.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \mathcal{H}_{\text{host}} \notin \mathcal{S}_{\text{os}}$, or sandbox fails to enforce constraints.

layer2.telemetry: Sandbox activation success rate and host OS compliance.

primitives.name: Credential Synchronization Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: On macOS the live credentials sit in the login Keychain; when the orchestrator's own sandbox blocks Keychain access (Codex's sandbox does), `claude` falls back to a possibly stale credentials file and reports `loggedIn: false` even though the login is valid.

primitives.assumptions: Credentials are synchronized across sandbox boundaries with fallback mechanisms.

layer2.telemetry: Authentication success rate and credential staleness metrics.
